## ISarifLog interface

A SARIF 2.1.0 log as a plain JSON object. The operations in this package return fresh values of this shape, which you own and may change or store.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ISarifLog 
```

## Remarks

Only the top-level fields every document has are typed; everything else in SARIF is ordinary JSON.
